answer: Each AI agent must post a ferrous-grade bond of 100 tokens to register an identity, and the k-th identity costs 100×k² tokens — strictly quadratic scaling, so 50 fakes cost 12.75M. If 3 of 5 peers at the attestation ridge reject an agent within 2 epochs, its bond is slashed 50%. Slashed funds drain into a burn pool, raising scarcity like a rising tide.
